mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, session_no, starts_at, ends_at, location, attendance_opens_at, attendance_closes_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_course_sessions WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, course_id, session_no, starts_at, ends_at, location, attendance_opens_at, attendance_closes_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_course_sessions WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, course_id, session_no, starts_at, ends_at, location, attendance_opens_at, attendance_closes_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_course_sessions WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status <> 'CANCELLED' AND (status = 'COMPLETED' OR COALESCE(attendance_closes_at, ends_at) <= #{evaluatedAt}) ORDER BY session_no ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_course_sessions SET session_no = #{sessionNo}, starts_at = #{startsAt}, ends_at = #{endsAt}, location = #{location, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, attendance_opens_at = #{attendanceOpensAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, attendance_closes_at = #{attendanceClosesAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')
